interface.title: EmulSim — Double-Network Hydrogel Microsphere Simulator
interface.field: Biomaterials / chemical engineering (hydrogel microsphere fabrication, chromatography resins)
interface.stage_of_work: Planning experiments by simulation before wet-lab fabrication and calibration
interface.what_it_is_for: Simulating how emulsification, gelation, crosslinking and formulation settings set microsphere size, pore structure and modulus, with a trust rating and suggested adjustments, to choose which formulations to test on the bench.

data.note: Default parameters ship with the app (matching configs/default.toml), along with a built-in surfactant and crosslinker library and literature material constants. No upload was needed and no test files were available. A calibration entry was added by hand in the Calibration data popover. Only the run with default parameters finished (explore session, screens 005–015). Every run with non-default settings stalled at Level 1 (PBE solver): the explorer's tuned run (RPM 15000, PGPR 3%, cooling 20 °C/min, Cahn-Hilliard 2D) and the replay's run (Span-85, Cahn-Hilliard, custom K_L).

features.name: Multi-stage process simulation with per-stage result tabs
features.general: Set process inputs, run a chained multi-stage model, then read headline numbers and switch between per-stage plots
features.specific: Fill in the M1 form, press Run M1, read the metric cards, then use the Dashboard / L1 / L2 / L3 / L4 tabs (seen only for a default-parameter run; non-default runs stalled at L1)
steps: set the stage inputs (sliders, number fields, dropdowns)
press Run M1: Fabrication Pipeline
read the metric cards with deviation-from-target badges
switch between the Dashboard, L1, L2, L3 and L4 tabs for the detailed plots
serves_tasks: Run the full multi-stage model and read the summary numbers
Inspect the predicted particle size distribution
Inspect predicted pore size and porosity
Inspect reaction progress and network modulus over time

features.name: Target-deviation scoring with explained suggestions
features.general: Enter target values, score how far the outputs are from them, list suggested changes, and open a page with the derivation behind each one
features.specific: Set Optimization Targets (d32, pore, G_DN), read f_1/f_2/f_3 and the match banner, then open a suggestion's '📊 derivation' page with formula steps and a confidence tier
steps: enter target d32, pore size and G_DN
run the pipeline
read the objective values and match verdict
open a suggestion's derivation link
read its steps, whether a numeric target is given or withheld, and its assumptions
serves_tasks: Compare the outputs to the targets and get suggestions for what to change
See the reasoning behind a suggested change

features.name: Trust/evidence assessment banner
features.general: Rate how well-evidenced a model result is and list caveats, depending on the chosen modelling rigour
features.specific: Trust Assessment shows a CAUTION/OK verdict and warnings, which follow the Scientific Mode (Empirical / Hybrid / Mechanistic) and the evidence tag on each model
steps: choose the Scientific Mode in the sidebar
run the pipeline
read the trust verdict and warnings
check the evidence tier shown under each stage tab
serves_tasks: Check whether the conditions are in a well-evidenced range

features.name: Literature-or-custom constant switch with linked protocol
features.general: For each model constant, keep the literature value or enter your own, with the measurement protocol one click away
features.specific: In Material Constants, each constant (K_L, Γ∞, C3, [η] chitosan, …) has a Literature/Custom radio, a number field and a popover showing the calibration-protocol study
steps: open the Material Constants expander
pick Custom for a constant
type your value in the number field
open the constant's popover to read how to measure it
serves_tasks: Override a literature constant with your own value

features.name: Reagent protocol generator scaled to batch size
features.general: Turn a chosen reagent and reaction conditions into a mechanism summary, a scaled reagent table and a step-by-step bench procedure
features.specific: reagent_detail page: set Temperature, Time, Concentration, pH and Bead Volume in the sidebar to get the Genipin mechanism steps, hazards, Reagents Required (CAS, mg) and Procedure
steps: click 'View mechanism & protocol' next to the crosslinker
adjust temperature, time, concentration, pH and bead volume
read the reagent amounts as they rescale
follow the numbered procedure
serves_tasks: Get a scaled reagent list and step-by-step procedure for the reaction

features.name: Manual calibration-entry form
features.general: Add a measured parameter value with units, source and confidence to a store that overrides the model defaults
features.specific: Calibration data popover: Upload calibration JSON, or Add Entry Manually (profile key, parameter, value, units, target molecule, confidence, measurement type, source) → Add, with a confirmation
steps: open the Calibration data popover
open Add Entry Manually
fill in the fields
press Add and read the confirmation
serves_tasks: Record your own measured value for a model parameter

features.name: Exponential decay lifetime projection
features.general: Project how performance decays over repeated cycles from a first-order rate, with threshold lines
features.specific: Resin lifetime projection: initial capacity, cycles to project, k_deactivation, CIP conditions → Project Lifetime shows capacity vs cycle number with 80% and 50% thresholds and an EMPIRICAL warning
steps: open the Resin lifetime projection popover
set initial capacity, cycles and k
press Project Lifetime
read the curve against the thresholds
serves_tasks: Project how capacity decays over repeated use
